channel.description: Recent content in Paper Reviews on Yunseo Choi

item.title: Automated Sewing System Enabled by Machine Vision for Smart Garment Manufacturing
item.description: A pattern-former that combines instance segmentation (YOLOv5) and reflection-based seam-line detection to automate top stitching of overlapped fabric layers.

item.title: Spatial-Temporal Synchronous Graph Convolutional Networks (STSGCN)
item.description: A graph-convolutional architecture that captures localized spatial–temporal correlations synchronously rather than in a sequential spatial→temporal pipeline.

item.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
item.description: CLIP pre-trains image and text encoders with a contrastive objective on 400M image–text pairs, enabling zero-shot transfer to many downstream image classification tasks.

item.title: SMPL: A Skinned Multi-Person Linear Model
item.description: A vertex-based, learned 3D human body model that combines blend skinning with shape and pose blend shapes — compatible with standard animation software.
